scripts.test: npm run test:config && npm run test:canvaskit-runtime && npm run test:appearance && npm run test:dice-svg && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:discord-rest && npm run test:interactions && npm run test:roll && npm run test:data && npm run test:web-api
scripts.test:canvaskit-runtime: npm run canvaskit:verify && vitest run --config vitest.canvaskit-runtime.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.canvaskit-r4-resource.config.ts
scripts.types: rm -rf .generated && mkdir -p .generated && wrangler types .generated/data.d.ts --config wrangler.data.example.jsonc --env-interface DataBindings && wrangler types .generated/discord-rest.d.ts --config wrangler.discord-rest.example.jsonc --env-interface DiscordRestBindings --include-runtime false && wrangler types .generated/gateway.d.ts --config wrangler.gateway.example.jsonc --env-interface GatewayBindings --include-runtime false && wrangler types .generated/interactions.d.ts --config wrangler.interactions.example.jsonc --env-interface InteractionBindings --include-runtime false && wrangler types .generated/roll.d.ts --config wrangler.roll.example.jsonc --env-interface RollBindings --include-runtime false && wrangler types .generated/web-api.d.ts --config wrangler.web-api.example.jsonc --env-interface WebApiBindings --include-runtime false
scripts.type-check: npm run types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.roll.json && npm run type-check:canvaskit-runtime
